questions.question_en:
If any question arises as to the age of a judge of a High Court, the question shall be decided by the
President after consultation with:
options_en: The Chief Justice of the concerned High Court
The Governor of the concerned state

questions.source: Laxmikanth 8th ed. appendix · Practice Questions (Question Set II) Q190
questions.question_en:
Which of the following statements are correct regarding the powers of a Governor to reserve a bill
for the consideration of the President?
1. It is laid down in Article 200.
2. It is not a discretionary power of the Governor.
3. It is compulsory, if the bill endangers the position of High Court.
